text: Developing a mobile app involves more than just writing code; it requires thoughtful planning around user experience and technical choices. One crucial aspect is responsive design, ensuring the app looks and functions well on various screen sizes, from small phones to large tablets. Developers also face a major decision between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built specifically for iOS or Android, offering top performance and access to device features, while cross-platform tools like Flutter allow a single codebase for both, saving time and cost. Finally, apps must be published through official app stores, which have strict review guidelines. After launch, performance monitoring is vital, as slow loading or crashes lead to poor user ratings and uninstalls.
